Are you ready to shape the future of defense systems? Located in Liège, this opportunity offers a chance to lead groundbreaking advancements in system engineering. As Technical Director - Systems Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex defense technologies into modular, software-centric solutions that redefine industry standards. Join a dynamic sector where your expertise will drive progress and make an impact.

As the Technical Director - Systems Engineering, you will be responsible for ensuring technical excellence across all aspects of system architecture, integration, industrialization, and lifecycle support. Your leadership will be instrumental in transitioning from product-focused operations to integrated, modular systems that prioritize execution and innovation. Key responsibilities include:

• System Architecture Mastery: Define and oversee reference architectures (mechanical, electronic, software, interfaces) while ensuring seamless integration between effectors, sensors, embedded software, connectivity, and lifecycle support requirements.
• Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Act as the de facto Head of System Engineering, making critical technical decisions across the portfolio and serving as the authority for programs, production teams, technology partners, and demanding military clients.
• Software & Robotic Systems Development: Establish software as a core industrial pillar by advancing practices in real-time robotics, control-command systems, safety-critical software, and cyber resilience. Promote simulation tools, digital twins, automated testing, and continuous integration tailored to high-stakes environments.
• Execution & Industrialization: Ensure architectural choices are scalable for mass production while maintaining cost efficiency. Collaborate closely with production departments, supply chain teams, quality assurance units, and lifecycle support experts to avoid prototype stagnation.
• Technological Partnerships: Drive strategic partnerships in areas such as sensors, counter-UAS systems, autonomy software, and more. Integrate external components seamlessly without compromising system integrity.

To excel in this role as Technical Director - Systems Engineering you should bring:

• Experience:
• 15+ years in engineering complex systems.
• Background in performance robotics (e.g., military/security robotics, drones/autonomous systems, critical industrial robotics).
• Proven track record in hardware/software integration, multi-disciplinary systems development, serial production implementation, and long lifecycle management within certified/safety-critical environments.
• Fluency in French and English is a must.
• Key Technical Skills:
• Expertise in system engineering with a holistic approach.
• Proficiency in mechatronic architectures, embedded electronics design, real-time software/middleware/communication frameworks.
• Deep understanding of trade-offs between performance vs. cost, sophistication vs. robustness, and innovation vs. industrialization.
• Leadership Qualities:
• Strategic technical leadership with decision-making authority.
• Ability to standardize processes and confidently say "no" when necessary.
• Comfortable navigating constrained industrial environments with exposure to demanding clients like armed forces.
• Credibility among senior engineers, program managers, and high-level technology partners.

jobs.occupation: Join Our Team as an Order Picker Warehouse Associate – Start Immediately in a Dynamic Environment!
jobs.description:
As an order picker warehouse associate, you play a key role in the warehouse operation. You will operate a high-level order picker truck (VNA), allowing you to safely pick products from elevated racks. Using a handheld scanner, you accurately check locations, quantities, and the correctness of orders. Your effort ensures that customers receive the right products on time and keeps the logistics process running smoothly.

On a typical workday, you collect customer orders by picking products from various warehouse locations. You work closely with colleagues, strictly follow safety instructions, and keep your workspace clean. You check products for damage or missing items and report these to the team leader. Packing and preparing orders for shipment is also part of your tasks, ensuring everything is ready to go out to customers efficiently.

Are you physically fit, detail-oriented, and do you enjoy a varied job in logistics? Apply today and make a difference in a close-knit team where collaboration and safety are essential.

• Previous experience as an order picker or warehouse associate is a plus.
• Certificate of good conduct (criminal record certificate) required.
• License or certificate for high-level order picker truck is an advantage.
• English speaking skills at level 3/5 (for effective communication and understanding instructions).
• Good physical fitness: able to stand, walk, and lift up to 17 kg.
• Accurate, responsible, and able to work safely in a fast-paced environment.

Take over an established portfolio, not a blank page: live accounts, long-term contracts and a clear path to running a full programme.

IT Project Manager | Client Accounts | Brussels

Our client is a Belgian company specialised in integrating software solutions at its clients’ sites — heavily customised platforms it deploys, tailors and maintains in their environment, often for years.

What makes it stand out? Its accounts sit on long-term framework contracts. You inherit live projects, established relationships and a team that already knows the platforms, rather than starting from scratch.

Part of the technical delivery runs through an external partner, which makes managing the triangle between client, internal teams and partner a core part of the job rather than a side task.

As it grows, the company is looking for a senior IT Project Manager to take over an existing portfolio, with a path towards running a full programme already mapped out internally.

 

The job

• You take ownership of several client accounts: implementations, contractual commitments, budgets, service quality and the relationship with decision-makers.
• You are the point of contact between the client, the internal teams and the technical partner, and you keep a firm grip on the functional content of the work.
 
Role
• Lead implementation and upgrade projects at the client’s site, from scoping through to go-live.
• Manage budgets, deadlines and contractual commitments, arbitrating between what was promised to the client and what the partner can deliver.
• Steer the external partner day to day: capacity, quality of deliverables, deadlines and escalations.
• Work with the business analyst on scoping client needs: challenge requests, measure them against the platform and decide which customisations to retain.
• Follow up on run and ticketing, anticipate contractual and budgetary risks, and bring the difficult trade-offs to the client.
Profile
• Senior experience on the vendor side — integrator, software vendor or consultancy — deploying software solutions at external clients. A purely in-house background on corporate IT projects is not a fit for this role.
• Comfortable with the functional side: you understand the solutions you deploy and can challenge an analysis rather than only coordinate. You also know your way around contractual mechanics, fixed-price and time-and-materials alike.
• Fluent English is essential; diplomacy, administrative rigour and the ability to hold your ground with a demanding client.
